- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes — adjust downward bias by 2–3% of recent range.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below prior peak if sentiment turns neutral or negative.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 1–2% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment was negative 3–5 days prior, reduce forecast by 1–2% for next 3–5 days.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate volatility in early 2025 — apply 5–10% downward correction if sentiment is volatile or mixed.
